# Initech — Buyer Personas

Version 2.1 · Updated April 8, 2026 by Daniela Herrera (Acme Digital) with input from Initech Sales (Luis Garza) · Based on 24 customer interviews: 15 in the US and 9 in Mexico.

## Persona 1: Carla, Corporate Controller

- Titles: Corporate Controller, Accounting Manager, Assistant Controller.
- Company size: 200–1,000 employees, mostly in distribution and manufacturing.
- Pains: month-end close takes 9 to 12 business days; reconciliations live in spreadsheets; audit prep eats two weeks every year.
- Objections: "We just finished an ERP rollout"; needs to be live in under 8 weeks; has little IT bandwidth.
- Channels: LinkedIn (Document Ads and newsletters), webinars, peer accounting communities.
- Content that converts: the Mid-Market Close Benchmark eBook and month-end close checklists.

## Persona 2: Marco, VP of Finance

- Titles: VP of Finance, CFO, Finance Director.
- Company size: 500–2,000 employees, often with subsidiaries in Mexico.
- Pains: no real-time view of cash and liabilities; a hiring freeze while invoice volume keeps growing; CFDI 4.0 e-invoicing compliance for the Mexican entities.
- Objections: price, since a typical contract runs above $40,000 a year; wants proof of ROI before talking to sales; worries about change management.
- Channels: LinkedIn, executive roundtables, peer recommendations, analyst and software review sites.
- Content that converts: the AP Automation ROI Calculator and case studies with hard numbers.

## Persona 3: Diana, Accounts Payable Manager

- Titles: AP Manager, AP Supervisor, Accounts Payable Lead.
- Company size: 200–2,000 employees, with AP teams of 3 to 10 clerks.
- Pains: more than 3,000 invoices a month keyed in by hand; duplicate payments; vendors calling to ask when they will get paid.
- Objections: fears automation will shrink her team; worried about the learning curve; "our ERP already does this".
- Channels: Google Search, YouTube tutorials, Spanish-language webinars (Mexico), WhatsApp groups of AP professionals.
- Content that converts: webinar replays, how-to videos and invoice-processing checklists.

## How to Use These Personas

- LinkedIn targeting: reach Carla and Diana by job title, and Marco by seniority (VP, CXO) plus the Finance job function.
- Messaging: lead with time saved for Carla, with cash visibility and ROI for Marco, and with less manual work (not fewer people) for Diana.
- Language: Mexico campaigns use Spanish for Carla and Diana; Marco often prefers English.
- Review these personas every six months with Initech Sales; the next review is due in October 2026.
